name: What defines a luxury condo in Miami Beach?

mainEntity.name: What defines a luxury condo in Miami Beach?

acceptedAnswer.text: Luxury condos in Miami Beach typically offer high-end finishes, premium amenities like private elevators, concierge services, and exclusive beach access. They often feature expansive floor plans, state-of-the-art appliances, and breathtaking views of the ocean or city. Beyond physical attributes, a luxury designation is also influenced by location within sought-after neighborhoods like South Beach or Bal Harbour, and the building's reputation for service and exclusivity.
acceptedAnswer.description: Luxury condos in Miami Beach feature high-end finishes, premium amenities, expansive views, and are located in exclusive neighborhoods known for service and exclusivity.
